sentences.text:
Author: D.Dash
Bench: D.Dash
 Ablapl No.15607 Of 2020
 03. 26.02.2021
This matter is taken up through hybrid arrangement  (virtual/physical) mode.

The petitioner having been implicated in connection with  Chauliaganj P.S. Case No.420 of 2020 corresponding to G.R. Case  No.1423 of 2020 running for alleged commission of offence under sections 272/273/420/34, I.P.C. and section 51/52/53/56/57/59/63   Food Safety and Standard Act and section 16 of the Prevention of  Food Adulteration Act and section 32 of the Metrology Packing and  Commodities Act pending in the court of learned J.M.F.C. (City),
 Cuttack, has filed this application for grant of anticipatory bai
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned cou  for the State.

Considering the submissions and viewing the materials on  record as also other surrounding circumstances, while being not  inclined to grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioner, this ap  is disposed of with the observation that in the event the petitio  surrenders before the court in seisin of the aforesaid case and m  for his release on bail, the same shall be considered on its own   further taking into account the factum of release of co-accused p  on bail and if similarly situated on the ground of parity, as per  without being prejudiced by this order and disposed of early in  accordance with law.
 The ABLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
 Issue urgent certified copy as per rules.

.........................
 D.Dash, J.
H ABLAPL/15607/2020 on 26 February, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188660265/
